# Vimeo

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 29 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Video product marketing and a signed-out watch shell: cyan brand action, cool gray page, ABC Repro display type, 12 and 16px buttons.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (marketing, watch feed, pricing, and the login dialog; no account created). Themes: light.

Public signed-out surfaces of Vimeo (vimeo.com). Tokens were read on 2026-11-19 from the marketing page, the signed-out watch feed, pricing, and the login wall. A 2026-11-22 refresh mapped the public control tree into [site-tree.md](site-tree.md) and photographed the homepage, four header menus, the footer, pricing, features, what's new, about, solutions, enterprise, the video player page, customer stories, the blog, the signed-out watch feed, one public video, the phone homepage and menu drawer, and the empty login and signup walls. No account was created. Themes observed: light on the marketing home, and a dark features index. Widths measured: 1440 and 390. `login-extracted` stays not-started. catalog.json was left alone.

### Fonts (from README.md)

ABC Repro, ABC Repro Medium, and ABC Repro Mono are proprietary. The tokens name them and fall back to system-ui, Helvetica, and Arial. They are not shipped in this package.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The 2026-11-19 pass could not screenshot watch, pricing, or login in the preview browser. Those pages were photographed on 2026-11-22. The new shots are full-colour PNGs at 2×. Older marketing shots under `screenshots/marketing-light-*` are 256-colour PNGs. Read colours from the tokens.

Pricing figures on `/upgrade-plan` were shown in Singapore dollars on both passes. Those amounts are geo-priced and are not tokens. The plan card radius computed as `36.8px`, while `--vimeo-radii-3xl` is `36px`. The card token keeps the computed value.

`--vimeo-fontWeights-regular` computed as `350`. Several buttons computed `font-weight: 400` on `ABCRepro-Medium`. Both readings are kept. The marketing home stayed light. The features index painted a dark page. That dark page was photographed and was not turned into a dark token set.

A public video URL loaded in the preview browser and hit a Cloudflare verify wall in headless Chromium. The wall shot was discarded. The checkbox was not clicked.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the cyan brand for the primary action.** The marketing Join and Start for free controls, and the auth Continue with email button, are `#17d5ff`. See [components/crops/button-primary-default.png](components/crops/button-primary-default.png).
- **Keep the app page on the cool gray.** Watch and pricing use `#f6f8fa`, not pure white. Surfaces and the auth dialog are white.
- **Set body type in ABC Repro, with a system fallback.** Marketing display is 72px at weight 500 and -3.6px tracking. The app uses the same family at smaller sizes.
- **Use 12px and 16px radii on buttons.** Header controls are 12px. The cyan email submit and pricing trial buttons are 16px. Do not invent a single radius.
- **Leave prices out of the system.** The amounts on the pricing page depend on the visitor's region.
